title: First CIA director on the NICAP board

tellings.quote: He was the first CIA director, Navy Admiral and he was on the board of directors for New Fork.

plain: Roscoe Hillenkoetter, the first director of the CIA and a Navy admiral, is said to have sat on the board of directors of NICAP, a private civilian group that collected and studied UFO reports in the 1950s and 60s. A guest named Dylan Borland tells Michels this without naming a source, as a sign that a man at the very top of American intelligence took the subject seriously.
